UAE

Figure 5. Qualitative comparison of reconstruction fidelity across autoencoding paradigms. We visualize reconstructed samples from representative methods, including SD-VAE | 53], RAE [51], and our proposed UAE. Each row corresponds to reconstructions from a fixed source set spanning text, human, object, and artistic domains. UAE produces the most consistent and semantically faithful reconstructions, preserving both high-frequency details (e.g., texture and edge sharpness) and global structure (e.g., layout and color harmony), while reducing the blurring and semantic drift observed in SD-VAE and RAE. (The detail comparisons are denoted in the йо. boxes.)
